text: Deceuninck NV's own shareholder table (most recent on 25 August 2026) shows: Gramo BV 31.19%, H.P. Participaties Comm.V. 7.90%, founder family member Frank Deceuninck 5.08%, treasury shares 0.15% and 55.68% other shareholders.
short: Deceuninck's largest disclosed holder is Gramo BV with 31.19%.

source.name: Deceuninck: Shareholder structure
source.quote: In application of the Law of 2 May 2007, the latest report of participations that have been received shows the following breakdown of shareholders
source.note: Same page table: Gramo BV 43,537,559 shares (31.19%), H.P. Participaties Comm.V. 11,023,777 (7.90%), Frank Deceuninck 7,092,237 (5.08%), treasury shares 208,936 (0.15%), others 77,732,751 (55.68%).
